dataset: SmartCloud Optimizer simulated local demo data

pricing_assumptions.VM: INR 600 per vCPU-month + INR 150 per GB RAM-month + INR 4 per disk GB-month
pricing_assumptions.note: Illustrative flat rates, not a quote from a cloud provider.

recommendation_assumptions.rightsize_target: Half the current vCPU and RAM when current vCPU is at least 4; retain disk capacity.
recommendation_assumptions.schedule_target: Weekdays 8 PM to 8 AM and weekends, only when off-hours p95 CPU is at most 10% and memory at most 30%.
recommendation_assumptions.schedule_savings: 50% of listed monthly compute-resource cost, capped with other suggestions at resource cost.
recommendation_assumptions.confidence_and_risk: Rule-based estimates; validate provider SKU availability, workload peaks, SLAs, and change windows.

forecast_assumptions.method: Compare the last 7 days of price-weighted utilization with the previous 7 days; linearly extrapolate and cap the change at 20% per 30 days.
forecast_assumptions.limitation: A utilization-derived spend-pressure proxy, not historical billing or a provider forecast.

sustainability_assumptions.limitation: Illustrative factors applied to pending estimated savings, not measured energy use or carbon accounting.

patterns: Development and staging VMs idle from 8 PM to 8 AM and on weekends
Orphaned volumes and public IPs with zero observed activity
